name: alert_id
description: Unique UUID primary key for risk alert event

name: alert_date
description: Calendar date of detection - Partition key

name: detected_at
description: UTC timestamp when streaming anomaly was detected

name: event_timestamp
description: UTC timestamp of the underlying trigger event

name: portfolio_id
description: Trading portfolio book - FK to dim_portfolios, Clustering key

name: ticker
description: Financial instrument symbol - FK to dim_tickers, Clustering key

name: asset_class
description: Asset class classification (EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, CRYPTO, ETF)

name: alert_type
description: Anomaly category: FLASH_CRASH_DRAWDOWN, SINGLE_ORDER_FAT_FINGER, NOTIONAL_EXPOSURE_BREACH, CONCENTRATED_SELL_PRESSURE - Clustering key

name: severity
description: Severity level: INFO, WARNING, CRITICAL - Clustering key

name: _ingested_at
description: Audit timestamp when alert was loaded into BigQuery
